comparison.objective: Uncork a wine bottle while keeping it in its cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the bottle, screw a worm into cork, operate extraction leverage, and remove the cork versus adjust and lock a damping collar.
comparison.success_condition: Requires cork extraction and separation without displacing the bottle; no carriage stopping or setting-retention measurement. Rubric is complete, despite substantial mechanism changes across versions.
comparison.reason: Shared turning and bimanual stabilization are generic; cork engagement and high-force extraction are materially different.
